# True Corner Land Co.

> True Corner Land Co. buys vacant residential lots in Florida for cash. Owners send the lot's address or parcel number and get a cash offer. There is no listing and no agent, and a licensed Florida title company handles the closing.

True Corner Land Co. is based in St. Petersburg, Florida, and is a branch of ShortFin Labs LLC, a Florida company. It works with owners who would rather sell a vacant lot than keep paying taxes on it: many live out of state, inherited the lot, or bought it years ago and never built. It also works with home builders across Florida who want lots for new homes.

## How selling a lot works
- Send the lot's address or parcel number, the county, and a rough price if you have one, to fred@truecornerlandco.com.
- True Corner looks at the lot and replies with a cash offer. There is no obligation to accept.
- If the owner accepts, True Corner handles everything from the title transfer to the closing fees. A licensed Florida title company handles the closing, the owner can sign by mail or remotely from anywhere, and the money is wired directly to the owner.
